summary: Extend the existing POST /calculate boundary and the Calculator domain contract with a pow operation. Both targets are additive-only, standard-density: the API gains one enum value with no schema/route changes, and the OCL gains a post-only contract for pow with no precondition, matching ChangeBrief X4 / Change Context NFR1/§6. No breaking, money, authz, or formal signals apply, so no human gate is needed beyond the already-settled Brief.

human_gate.reason: additive_change only (new op enum value + new post-only OCL contract, no removals/tightenings); ChangeBrief already recorded human_gate.required=false with confidence=high and the no-precondition decision is explicit, non-ambiguous scope (X4), so no breaking_change, money_boundary, authz_boundary, or low_confidence signal fires here.

targets.rationale: http_boundary signal (POST /calculate) selects kind=api/openapi. additive_change signal (new enum value only, no new routes/fields/status codes, no removals) keeps density at standard rather than strict, and rules out a human gate on its own per judgment-axes.md combining rule 4. stable_core also applies (mature, already-shipped endpoint) which independently supports standard rather than thin.

domain_contract signal (Calculator module operation) selects kind=dbc/ocl. additive_change signal (new operation contract only) keeps density at standard, matching the sibling add/sub/mul contracts (post-only, no pre). The deliberate absence of a pre clause is a load-bearing scope decision from ChangeBrief X4 and Change Context NFR1/§6 (pow must not inherit the div/mod zero-divisor PreconditionError pattern) — not a lower-rigor judgment call, so density stays standard rather than thin.
